name: Hanceville Knapsacks for Kids
summary: Packs weekend food bags for Hanceville students who might otherwise go hungry. Each bag costs about $12, and volunteers pack on Thursdays at the Civic Center. A simple way to make a big difference.
how: Donate by Cash App to $knapsacks4 or by mail. Message their Facebook page to volunteer.

name: Hanceville Hope Pantry
summary: A free food pantry run by local church volunteers. Neighbors helping neighbors.

name: Lions' Kitchen at Wallace State
summary: A free food pantry for Wallace State students. You can donate through the Wallace State Future Foundation.

name: Cullman Caring for Kids
summary: One of the county's busiest food pantries, serving about 900 to 1,000 families a month. Donations of canned fruit and easy breakfast items are always welcome.

name: Hanceville Friends of the Festival
summary: The volunteers behind the Mud Creek Arts and Crafts Festival. Proceeds benefit Hanceville schools and the city, and vendors and sponsors are welcome.

name: Hanceville Civitan Club
summary: A local service club that brings people together with community events like pancake breakfasts.

name: Shirley Burden Public Library
summary: Donations to the library are tax deductible, and used book sales help fund children's programs. Shop the sale, support the kids.

name: Wallace State Future Foundation
summary: Raises money for more than 150 scholarships for Wallace State students. Invest in a neighbor's future.

name: The Willow Path
summary: Offers a 24 hour crisis line and emergency shelter for people facing abuse in Cullman County.

name: Brooks' Place Child Advocacy Center
summary: Helps children who may have been abused, and their families, through a caring and coordinated response.

name: United Way of Cullman County
summary: Runs 211, which connects people to local help, and supports partner agencies across the county.
